def _regions_for_export(
    region_identifiers: Iterable[str] | None,
    source_keys: Iterable[str] | None,
) -> list[TripRegion]:
    identifiers = [
        identifier for identifier in (region_identifiers or []) if identifier
    ]
    source_key_list = [source_key for source_key in (source_keys or []) if source_key]

    queryset = TripRegion.objects.all()
    if identifiers:
        region_filter = Q()
        for identifier in identifiers:
            region_filter |= Q(slug__iexact=identifier) | Q(name__iexact=identifier)
        queryset = queryset.filter(region_filter)
    elif source_key_list:
        queryset = queryset.filter(
            calendar__event_sources__source_key__in=source_key_list
        )
    else:
        queryset = queryset.filter(is_active=True)

    return list(queryset.distinct().order_by("sort_order", "name", "id"))


def _serialize_region(
    region: TripRegion,
    *,
    source_keys: set[str],
    include_inactive: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        region_calendar = region.calendar
    except RegionCalendar.DoesNotExist:
        region_calendar = None

    event_sources = []
    rss_feed_sources = []
    events = []
    if region_calendar is not None:
        event_source_queryset = region_calendar.event_sources.all().order_by(
            "source_key"
        )
        rss_queryset = region_calendar.rss_feeds.select_related(
            "event_source"
        ).order_by(
            "name",
            "id",
        )
        event_queryset = region_calendar.events.select_related(
            "regional_area",
            "event_source",
            "matched_business",
        ).order_by("start_datetime", "id")

        if source_keys:
            event_source_queryset = event_source_queryset.filter(
                source_key__in=source_keys
            )
            rss_queryset = rss_queryset.filter(event_source__source_key__in=source_keys)
            event_queryset = event_queryset.filter(
                event_source__source_key__in=source_keys
            )

        if not include_inactive:
            event_queryset = event_queryset.filter(is_active=True)

        event_sources = [
            _serialize_event_source(source) for source in event_source_queryset
        ]
        rss_feed_sources = [_serialize_rss_feed_source(feed) for feed in rss_queryset]
        events = [_serialize_region_event(event) for event in event_queryset]

    return {
        "name": region.name,
        "slug": region.slug,
        "description": region.description,
        "tagline": region.tagline,
        "hero_image": region.hero_image,
        "thumbnail": region.thumbnail,

        "is_featured": region.is_featured,
        "sort_order": region.sort_order,
        "is_active": region.is_active,
        "areas": [
            _serialize_area(area)
            for area in region.areas.order_by("display_order", "name", "id")
            if include_inactive or area.is_active
        ],
        "business_listings": [
            _serialize_business_listing(business)
            for business in region.business_listings.prefetch_related(
                "aliases"
            ).order_by(
                "display_name",
                "id",
            )
            if include_inactive or business.is_active
        ],
        "event_sources": event_sources,
        "rss_feed_sources": rss_feed_sources,
        "events": events,
    }
